reports.title: What the shapes and colours mean

settings.description: Hexagon = the source. Circle = a person who paid others on (click to open them); square = a person who paid nobody on, the trail ends there. Colour = the layer they received the money in; the number inside is the traced amount. Orange arrow = part of that transfer is more than the person received, so it is not counted.

reports.title: Layered money trail

settings.description: P2P only. Starts with each source and the person it paid. Click a person to see who they paid next (one layer per click); the path stays open. Click a LAYER header to close everything. Arrow captions: traced amount, and in brackets the minus (orange arrows).

reports.title: Selected
reports.query:
// CARD - "Selected" (report type: Table, single row)
// The clicked person: the traced money they received, how many people
// they paid, what they sent, the minus, and what they kept.
WITH coalesce($neodash_lyr_focus, '') AS fk
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:LNet {key: fk})
RETURN CASE WHEN f IS NULL OR f:LHeader THEN 'nothing clicked' ELSE f.role END AS NODE,
       coalesce(f.acc, '')                AS ACCOUNT,
       f.tag                              AS TXN_SL_TAG,
       f.layer                            AS LAYER,
       round(f.traced_in, 2)              AS TRACED_IN,
       round(f.received, 2)               AS RECEIVED_P2P,
       f.pays                             AS PAYS_PEOPLE,
       round(f.sent, 2)                   AS SENT_P2P,
       round(f.traced_out, 2)             AS TRACED_OUT,
       round(f.excess, 2)                 AS MINUS_NOT_TRACED,
       round(f.kept, 2)                   AS KEPT,
       CASE WHEN size(coalesce(f.also_in_layers, [])) = 0 THEN ''
            ELSE reduce(s = '', l IN f.also_in_layers | CASE WHEN s = '' THEN '' ELSE s + ', ' END + toString(l))
       END                                AS ALSO_IN_LAYERS

reports.title: Does it add up? (kept by people = layer-1 amount)
reports.query:
// CARD - "Does it add up?" (report type: Table)
// Per trail: the layer-1 P2P amount, and the traced money every person
// kept after the last layer. KEPT equals START (CHECK = OK) - the
// "after the last layer it matches the first transfer" check. The rows
// left out of the trace (not P2P, or not SUCCESS) are counted for reference.
MATCH (s:LSource)
WITH s.tag AS tag, collect(s.acc) AS sources, sum(s.sent) AS start
MATCH (n:LAccount {tag: tag})
WITH tag, sources, start, max(n.layer) AS layers, count(n) AS people, sum(n.kept) AS kept
CALL {
  WITH tag
  MATCH (r:LyrTxn {tag: tag, p2p: false})
  RETURN count(r) AS skipped, coalesce(sum(r.amount), 0.0) AS skipped_amt
}
RETURN tag AS TXN_SL_TAG,
       reduce(s = '', a IN sources | CASE WHEN s = '' THEN a ELSE s + ', ' + a END) AS SOURCE,
       layers                AS LAYERS,
       people                AS PEOPLE,
       round(start, 2)       AS START,
       round(kept, 2)        AS KEPT_BY_PEOPLE,
       CASE WHEN abs(kept - start) < 0.005 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'MISMATCH' END AS CHECK,
       skipped               AS ROWS_LEFT_OUT,
       round(skipped_amt, 2) AS LEFT_OUT_AMOUNT
ORDER BY coalesce(toIntegerOrNull(TXN_SL_TAG), 0), TXN_SL_TAG

reports.title: By layer (follows the clicked trail)
reports.query:
// CARD - "By layer" (report type: Table)
// Per trail and layer, P2P only: what was sent, what of it is traced,
// the minus, and of the traced money what the people of that layer kept
// and what they passed on into the next layer.
// Follows the clicked person's trail; every trail when nothing is clicked.
WITH coalesce($neodash_lyr_focus, '') AS fk
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:LNet {key: fk})
WITH CASE WHEN f IS NULL OR f:LHeader THEN null ELSE f.tag END AS tag
MATCH (a)-[e:LFLOW]->(b:LNet)
WHERE tag IS NULL OR e.tag = tag
WITH e.tag AS t, e.layer AS L, b,
     sum(e.sent) AS sent, sum(e.amount) AS traced, sum(e.txn_count) AS txns
WITH t, L, sum(txns) AS txns, count(b) AS people, sum(sent) AS sent, sum(traced) AS traced,
     sum(b.kept) AS kept, sum(b.traced_out) AS passed_on
RETURN t AS TXN_SL_TAG, L AS LAYER, people AS PEOPLE, txns AS P2P_TXNS,
       round(sent, 2)          AS SENT,
       round(traced, 2)        AS TRACED,
       round(sent - traced, 2) AS MINUS_NOT_TRACED,
       round(kept, 2)          AS KEPT,
       round(passed_on, 2)     AS PASSED_ON
ORDER BY coalesce(toIntegerOrNull(TXN_SL_TAG), 0), TXN_SL_TAG, LAYER

reports.title: P2P transactions on the arrows shown (TRACED_AMT / MINUS_AMT)
reports.query:
// CARD - "Transactions" (report type: Table)
// The P2P rows on the arrows currently drawn (same rule as
// cards/graph.cypher), with what the trace counted.
//   TRACED_AMT - the part of TXN_AMT that carries the layer-1 money
//   MINUS_AMT  - TXN_AMT - TRACED_AMT (orange in the graph)
//   LAYERED_MONEY / DIFF - the sheet's own figure, when the table has that
//                column, and TRACED_AMT - LAYERED_MONEY (0 = they agree)
WITH coalesce($neodash_lyr_focus, '') AS fk
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:LNet {key: fk})
WITH coalesce(f.chain, []) AS chain
MATCH (n:LNet)
WHERE NOT n:LHeader AND (n.parent_key IS NULL OR n.layer = 1 OR n.parent_key IN chain)
WITH collect(n.key) AS shown
MATCH (r:LyrTxn {p2p: true})
WHERE r.to_key IN shown AND r.from_key IN shown
RETURN r.tag               AS TXN_SL_TAG,
       r.layer             AS LAYER,
       r.ts_text           AS APPROVAL_DATETIME,
       r.txn_id            AS TXN_ID,
       r.from_acc          AS TXN_FROM,
       r.with_acc          AS TXN_WITH,
       r.txn_type          AS TXN_TYPE,
       r.amount            AS TXN_AMT,
       round(r.traced, 2)  AS TRACED_AMT,
       round(r.excess, 2)  AS MINUS_AMT,
       r.layered_money     AS LAYERED_MONEY,
       CASE WHEN r.layered_money IS NULL THEN null ELSE round(r.traced - r.layered_money, 2) END AS DIFF,
       r.channel           AS CHANNEL,
       r.post_blc          AS POST_BLC
ORDER BY coalesce(toIntegerOrNull(TXN_SL_TAG), 0), TXN_SL_TAG, LAYER, r.ts

settings.description: TRACED_AMT is the part of TXN_AMT that carries the layer-1 money; MINUS_AMT is the rest (orange in the graph).
